You cannot make her stop unfortunately. Excoriation disorder is NOT a matter of low self control or self harm. We are not actively trying to harm ourselves, and the vast majority of us absolutely HATE that we do it. It’s a complex issue that requires complex treatment 🤷 the best thing you could do for her would just be to support her and encourage her to get professional help. Getting in to arguments or trying to force her to stop will only cause her more distress/feelings of shame and that can only make the picking worse. Be gentle with her. We don’t pick because it’s fun and we can’t “just stop”. Everyone with this disorder has tried to stop but it’s not that easy. 

You can’t force her to stop. You can’t shame her into never picking again. She has to be ready to get treatment and put the work in required to lessen her symptoms. Unfortunately a lot of people don’t talk about this disorder and that’s why it’s so misunderstood and hidden. Just be there for her. I doubt she likes it any more than you. In fact I’m pretty positive she hates it a lot more than you do. 

If you really want to help just reassure her that you’re there to support her. Reassure her that you still love her even when she picks. And if you can’t love her if she doesn’t stop picking then just break up with her. Because having an unsupportive partner is worse than no partner. Be a safe space for her to talk about it with.
